text_note.zh: 这里用课本的写法：原始资料的“童穉”“其傍”“自媿”，课本写作“童稚”“其旁”“自愧”，都是同一个意思的不同写法。原始资料最后两句之间漏了标点。
text_note.en: This follows the textbook. Three characters in the source, for "child", "beside" and "ashamed", are old variant forms; the textbook uses the modern ones with the same meaning. The source also drops the punctuation between the last two lines.

readings.zh: 荷，用肩膀挑着，读 hè，不读荷花的 hé。
readings.en: Here it means to carry on the shoulder, read hè, not hé as in lotus.

readings.zh: 箪食：现在一般读 dān shí。旧读 dān sì，“食”指饭食。
readings.en: Now usually read dān shí. The old reading is dān sì, with sì meaning cooked food.

readings.zh: 饷，给在地里干活的人送饭，读 xiǎng。
readings.en: Read xiǎng, meaning to bring food to people working in the field.
Read wèi here, meaning because of.

readings.zh: 这里读 céng。也有人按古义读 zēng，意思是“竟然”。
readings.en: Read céng here. Some read zēng, the old reading when it means "after all".

readings.zh: 石，古代计算粮食的单位，课本读 dàn。一说古书中应读 shí。
readings.en: As an old unit for grain it is read dàn in textbooks. Some say it should be read shí in old texts.

glosses.zh: 田家：农家，种地的人家。
glosses.en: tián jiā: farming families.

glosses.zh: 闲月：空闲的月份。
glosses.en: xián yuè: a free month, with little work.

glosses.zh: 倍忙：加倍忙碌。这里的五月是农历五月，正是收麦子的时候。
glosses.en: bèi máng: twice as busy. The fifth month of the old calendar is wheat harvest time.

glosses.zh: 覆陇黄：麦子成熟了，盖满了田垄，一片金黄。陇，通“垄”，田里种庄稼的土埂。
glosses.en: fù lǒng huáng: ripe wheat covers the field ridges in gold. Lǒng means the raised rows in a field.

glosses.zh: 妇姑：媳妇和婆婆，泛指家里的妇女。
glosses.en: fù gū: wives and their mothers-in-law, the women of the family.

glosses.zh: 荷箪食：挑着装饭的竹篮。箪，圆形的竹筐。
glosses.en: hè dān shí: carrying food in round bamboo baskets on a pole.

glosses.zh: 童稚：小孩子。
glosses.en: tóng zhì: young children.

glosses.zh: 壶浆：壶里装的汤水。
glosses.en: hú jiāng: drinks carried in a pot.

glosses.zh: 饷田：给在田里干活的人送饭。
glosses.en: xiǎng tián: to take food to the people in the fields.

glosses.zh: 丁壮：年轻力壮的男子。
glosses.en: dīng zhuàng: strong young men.

glosses.zh: 南冈：南边的山冈。冈，低矮的山坡。
glosses.en: nán gāng: the southern hill. Gāng is a low hill.

glosses.zh: 足蒸暑土气：脚下被晒热的泥土蒸着。
glosses.en: zú zhēng shǔ tǔ qì: their feet are steamed by the hot earth.

glosses.zh: 背灼炎天光：背上被火热的阳光烤着。灼，烤。
glosses.en: bèi zhuó yán tiān guāng: their backs are burned by the blazing sun. Zhuó means to scorch.

glosses.zh: 但惜：只是珍惜。
glosses.en: dàn xī: they only treasure.

glosses.zh: 其旁：他们旁边。
glosses.en: qí páng: beside them.

glosses.zh: 秉遗穗：拿着拾来的麦穗。秉，拿着；遗穗，收割时掉在地里的麦穗。
glosses.en: bǐng yí suì: holding wheat ears picked up from the ground. Bǐng means to hold; yí suì are ears dropped in the harvest.

glosses.zh: 悬敝筐：挂着一个破筐。敝，破旧。
glosses.en: xuán bì kuāng: a worn-out basket hangs from her arm. Bì means worn out.

glosses.zh: 相顾言：互相看着说话。这里指那妇人对别人诉说。
glosses.en: xiāng gù yán: talking while looking at each other; here, the woman tells the others her story.

glosses.zh: 输税尽：交税交光了。输，交纳。
glosses.en: shū shuì jìn: everything has gone to pay taxes. Shū means to hand over.

glosses.zh: 充饥肠：填饱饿肚子。
glosses.en: chōng jī cháng: to fill an empty stomach.

glosses.zh: 功德：功劳和德行。
glosses.en: gōng dé: good deeds, merit.

glosses.zh: 不事农桑：不种地，也不养蚕。事，做；桑，种桑养蚕。
glosses.en: bù shì nóng sāng: not farming or raising silkworms. Shì means to do; sāng is mulberry, for silkworms.

glosses.zh: 吏禄：做官的俸禄，也就是官员的工资。
glosses.en: lì lù: an official's pay.

glosses.zh: 三百石：三百石粮食。白居易当县尉，一年的俸禄大约是这个数。
glosses.en: sān bǎi dàn: three hundred measures of grain, about a year's pay for Bai Juyi as a county officer.

glosses.zh: 岁晏：年底。晏，晚。
glosses.en: suì yàn: the end of the year. Yàn means late.

glosses.zh: 私自愧：自己心里暗暗觉得惭愧。
glosses.en: sī zì kuì: secretly feeling ashamed of himself.

glosses.zh: 尽日：整天。
glosses.en: jìn rì: all day long.

translation.zh: 种地的人家很少有空闲的月份，
translation.en: Farm families have few free months.

translation.zh: 到了五月，人们加倍地忙。
translation.en: In the fifth month they are twice as busy.

translation.zh: 夜里吹起了南风，
translation.en: At night the south wind rises,

translation.zh: 小麦熟了，田垄上一片金黄。
translation.en: and the ripe wheat turns the field ridges gold.

translation.zh: 媳妇和婆婆挑着竹篮装的饭，
translation.en: Wives and mothers-in-law carry baskets of food on poles.

translation.zh: 小孩子提着壶里的汤水，
translation.en: Children bring pots of drink.

translation.zh: 一个跟着一个去给地里的人送饭，
translation.en: One after another they take food to the fields,

translation.zh: 男人们正在南边的山冈上割麦。
translation.en: where the strong men are cutting wheat on the southern hill.

translation.zh: 脚下被晒热的土地蒸着，
translation.en: Their feet are steamed by the hot earth,

translation.zh: 背上被火热的阳光烤着。
translation.en: their backs burned by the blazing sun.

translation.zh: 累得没力气了，也顾不上热，
translation.en: Worn out, they no longer feel the heat,

translation.zh: 只盼着夏天的白天长一些，好多干活。
translation.en: and only wish the summer day were longer.

translation.zh: 又看见一个穷苦的妇人，
translation.en: Then there is a poor woman

translation.zh: 抱着孩子，站在他们旁边。
translation.en: holding a child, standing beside them.

translation.zh: 右手拿着拾来的麦穗，
translation.en: In her right hand she holds ears of wheat she has picked up.

translation.zh: 左胳膊上挂着一个破筐。
translation.en: From her left arm hangs a worn-out basket.

translation.zh: 听她对别人说的话，
translation.en: Hearing what she tells the others,

translation.zh: 听的人都为她难过。
translation.en: everyone who listens feels sad.

translation.zh: 家里的田地，收成都交税交光了，
translation.en: "All our own harvest went to pay the tax,

translation.zh: 只好拾些麦穗来填饱肚子。
translation.en: so I pick up these ears to fill our empty stomachs."

translation.zh: 如今我有什么功劳和德行？
translation.en: And I, what merit do I have?

translation.zh: 从来不种地，也不养蚕。
translation.en: I have never farmed or raised silkworms.

translation.zh: 做官的俸禄有三百石，
translation.en: My pay as an official is three hundred measures of grain,

translation.zh: 到了年底还有吃不完的粮食。
translation.en: and at the year's end I still have grain to spare.

translation.zh: 想到这些，我心里暗暗惭愧，
translation.en: Thinking of this, I feel ashamed inside,

translation.zh: 一整天都忘不了。
translation.en: and all day long I cannot forget it.

background.zh: 这首诗写于唐宪宗元和二年（807年）前后，白居易当时在盩厔（今陕西周至）当县尉，是县里管治安、催收赋税的小官。麦收时节，他亲眼看到农民在烈日下割麦，又看到一个交完税只能拾麦穗充饥的穷妇人，心里很不安，写下了这首诗。
background.en: Bai Juyi wrote this poem around 807, when he was a minor county officer in Zhouzhi, in today's Shaanxi. His job included keeping order and collecting taxes. At harvest time he saw farmers cutting wheat under the burning sun. He also saw a poor woman who had paid all her grain in taxes and could only pick up stray ears to eat. It troubled him, and he wrote this poem.

author_note.zh: 白居易（772—846），字乐天，唐代大诗人。他主张诗歌要反映现实、关心百姓，写得通俗易懂，传说连不识字的老婆婆都能听懂。《观刈麦》《卖炭翁》都是这类为百姓说话的诗。
author_note.en: Bai Juyi (772–846), also called Letian, was a great Tang poet. He believed poems should show real life and care about common people. He wrote so plainly that, the story goes, even an old woman who could not read understood his poems. "Watching the Wheat Harvest" and "The Old Charcoal Seller" are poems of this kind, speaking up for ordinary people.

appreciation.zh: 诗人像站在田边，把看到的一幕一幕写下来。先是全家出动：女人挑饭，孩子提水，男人在山冈上割麦。脚下烫，背上晒，累得都不觉得热了，还嫌白天太短。接着出现一个抱着孩子拾麦穗的穷妇人，她家的粮食全交了税。最后诗人把镜头转向自己：我不种地，却有吃不完的粮食。这份惭愧，是一个官员真诚的反省。全诗语言朴素，没有华丽的词，却让人看到了农民的辛苦，也看到了诗人的良心。
appreciation.en: The poet seems to stand by the field and write down one scene after another. First the whole family is at work. The women carry food, the children bring drink, and the men cut wheat on the hill. The ground is hot under their feet, the sun burns their backs, and they are too tired to feel the heat. They even wish the day were longer. Then a poor woman appears, holding her child and picking up stray wheat. All her family's grain went to pay taxes. At last the poet turns the camera on himself. He does not farm, yet he has more grain than he can eat. His shame is an official's honest look at himself. The words are plain, with nothing fancy, yet we see both the farmers' hard work and the poet's conscience.
